authoritative_backend.note: Prove an available task-appropriate authoritative backend before backend-owned runtime activation.

google_play_billing_sandbox.note: No credential or account identifier belongs in this file.

google_signin_oauth.note: Shipping package/signing identity and OAuth configuration must be proven at activation.

cloud_backend.note: Cloud persistence/identity service availability must be proven without committing credentials.

remote_config_backend.note: LiveOps remote configuration/kill-switch backend must be available before service integration.

telemetry_backend.note: Privacy-safe telemetry sink availability must be proven before T42 service integration.

platform_achievement_backend.note: Platform achievement/milestone service availability must be proven before T57 integration.

physical_phone_4k60.note: T68 requires a named representative physical phone and sustained native 4K/60 thermal evidence.

physical_tablet_foldable_4k60.note: T69 requires a named representative physical tablet/foldable and sustained native 4K/60 thermal evidence.

release_signing_identity.note: Release-signing readiness is tracked as status only; never commit signing material.

store_release_access.note: Store/release-channel access must be proven for T70 without storing credentials.
